test_plan.scope: Validate FR-071..FR-078: sustained latency/loss/DNS alert rules, WAN outage fire/resolve, public-IP change alerts, sustained_duration for host rules, settings alert-rule UI, and forward-only AlertConfig migration.
test_plan.approach: Three-layer pyramid. Unit tests pin sustained-window evaluator and metric-shape validation. Integration tests exercise SQLite migrations, /api/alerts/rules, alert engine evaluation against temp SQLite NetSample/NetEvent rows, and notification callback counts. E2E tests drive /settings -> Alert rules with Playwright-style assertions for progressive disclosure and table partial swaps.
fixtures: tmpDB(t) creates SQLite in t.TempDir() and runs the in-tree schema/migration runner
seedSession(t, db) creates user id=1, session id='sess-test', csrf_token='csrf-test'
seedNetSamples inserts concrete NetSample rows with ts in Unix milliseconds, target, kind, rtt_ms, status
fakeDispatcher records fire events and resolve events as arrays with severity, source, message, value
fakeClock starts at 2026-05-11T10:00:00Z and advances in 5s ticks
test_plan.exit_criteria: All MUST FRs have at least happy, edge, and negative/failure coverage; at least two E2E flows pass; no tests depend on absolute paths; no no_go_zone behavior is asserted.

test_cases.title: Latency rule fires once after 120s of RTT above 100ms
preconditions: tmpDB with AlertConfig id=71 metric='latency' target='gateway' operator='>' threshold=100 sustained_duration=120 severity='warning' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
24 NetSample rows for target='gateway' kind='icmp' status='ok' rtt_ms=125 at 5s intervals from 2026-05-11T10:00:00Z through 10:01:55Z
fakeDispatcher attached to Engine rich callback
test_cases.given: AlertConfig id=71 targets gateway latency >100ms for sustained_duration=120s and all 24 gateway RTT samples are 125ms
test_cases.when: Engine evaluates once per 5s tick from 2026-05-11T10:00:00Z through 10:02:00Z
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row is inserted with source='latency', severity='warning', value=125; fakeDispatcher fire count is 1 and message contains 'gateway', '125', '100', and '120'
test_cases.expected_result: 1 persisted fire alert and 1 notification fire; no duplicate fire before 10:17:00Z

test_cases.title: Latency cooldown suppresses duplicate fires for continuing breach
preconditions: tmpDB with AlertConfig id=72 metric='latency' target='8.8.8.8' operator='>' threshold=100 sustained_duration=120 severity='warning' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
240 NetSample rows for target='8.8.8.8' kind='icmp' status='ok' rtt_ms=140 at 5s intervals from 2026-05-11T10:00:00Z through 10:19:55Z
test_cases.given: RTT to 8.8.8.8 remains 140ms for 20 minutes after the first eligible fire at 10:02:00Z
test_cases.then: Exactly 2 Alert rows exist for config_id=72: first created_at between 10:02:00Z and 10:02:05Z, second created_at at or after 10:17:00Z; no row exists between 10:02:06Z and 10:16:59Z
test_cases.expected_result: Cooldown suppresses all duplicate fires inside the 15-minute window

test_cases.title: Unknown latency target is rejected with HTTP 400
preconditions: httptest server has configured targets ['gateway','8.8.8.8','1.1.1.1']
authenticated session cookie 'sess-test' and csrf_token='csrf-test' exist
test_cases.given: Authenticated client posts metric='latency', target='8.8.8.8; rm -rf /', operator='>', threshold='100', sustained_duration='120', severity='warning', cooldown='15', csrf_token='csrf-test'
test_cases.then: Response status is 400 and body equals 'Invalid target\n'; AlertConfig row count remains 0
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 400 Invalid target and no persisted rule

test_cases.title: Packet-loss rule fires once after 60s above 5 percent
preconditions: AlertConfig id=721 metric='loss' target='gateway' operator='>' threshold=5 sustained_duration=60 severity='warning' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
12 gateway loss samples at 5s cadence expose loss_pct=8 from 10:00:00Z through 10:00:55Z
test_cases.given: Every probe sample in the trailing 60s for target gateway has loss_pct=8
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row is created with source='loss', severity='warning', value=8 and message contains 'gateway', '8', and '5'
test_cases.expected_result: One warning alert for gateway packet loss with current loss and threshold in body

test_cases.title: Alternating packet-loss samples reset sustained window
preconditions: SustainedWindow rule_id=722 duration=60s interval=5s operator='>' threshold=5
test_cases.given: The evaluator receives 12 values in order at 5s intervals: 8,0,8,0,8,0,8,0,8,0,8,0
test_cases.when: Each sample is added to the sustained window
test_cases.then: Window never reports eligible=true; fire count remains 0
test_cases.expected_result: No alert eligibility because every below-threshold sample resets the window

test_cases.title: Packet-loss target is required
preconditions: authenticated settings request with csrf_token='csrf-test'
test_cases.given: Client posts metric='loss', target='', operator='>', threshold='5', sustained_duration='60', severity='warning', cooldown='15', csrf_token='csrf-test'
test_cases.then: Response status is 400 and body equals 'Invalid target\n'; no AlertConfig row with metric='loss' exists
test_cases.expected_result: Missing target is rejected before persistence

test_cases.title: DNS failure-rate rule fires after 120s above 20 percent
preconditions: AlertConfig id=731 metric='dns_failure_rate' target=NULL operator='>' threshold=20 sustained_duration=120 severity='warning' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
For resolver target='1.1.1.1' kind='dns', 24 samples from 10:00:00Z to 10:01:55Z include 8 status='error' and 16 status='ok' in each computed window
test_cases.given: Aggregate DNS failure rate is 33.3 percent for the full 120s window
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row exists with source='dns_failure_rate', severity='warning'; message contains '1.1.1.1', '33.3', and '20'
test_cases.expected_result: One DNS failure-rate alert naming the contributing resolver and threshold

test_cases.title: DNS rule has no target field and observes all resolvers
preconditions: AlertConfig id=732 metric='dns_failure_rate' target=NULL operator='>' threshold=20 sustained_duration=120 severity='warning' enabled=1
target='1.1.1.1' has 0 percent failure; target='9.9.9.9' has 50 percent failure across 24 DNS samples
test_cases.given: The DNS rule target column is NULL and resolver 9.9.9.9 breaches the threshold while 1.1.1.1 does not
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row is created and its message contains '9.9.9.9'; the rule did not require a posted target
test_cases.expected_result: DNS rule evaluates the resolver population and reports the worst contributing resolver

test_cases.title: DNS rule skips when fewer than two samples exist
preconditions: AlertConfig id=733 metric='dns_failure_rate' threshold=20 sustained_duration=120 enabled=1
NetSample has exactly 1 row: target='1.1.1.1', kind='dns', status='error', ts=2026-05-11T10:00:00Z
test_cases.given: Only one DNS sample exists in the sustained window
test_cases.then: Alert table remains empty and captured log contains 'metric=dns_failure_rate' and 'reason=insufficient_dns_samples'
test_cases.expected_result: No alert is created; skip reason is observable in logs

test_cases.title: WAN down event fires critical alert on next engine tick
preconditions: AlertConfig id=741 metric='wan_outage' operator='==' threshold=0 severity='critical' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
NetEvent row id=1 ts=2026-05-11T10:03:00Z kind='wan_down' detail='3 consecutive failures to cloudflare (1.1.1.1); gateway still ok'
test_cases.given: A wan_outage rule is enabled and one wan_down event exists
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row exists with source='wan_outage', severity='critical', message containing 'WAN DOWN' and 'gateway still ok'; fakeDispatcher fire count is 1
test_cases.expected_result: Critical WAN outage fire is persisted and dispatched within one tick

test_cases.title: WAN up event emits info resolve inside prior cooldown
preconditions: AlertConfig id=742 metric='wan_outage' severity='critical' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
Engine previously fired wan_outage at 2026-05-11T10:03:05Z
NetEvent row id=2 ts=2026-05-11T10:07:00Z kind='wan_up' detail='recovered on 1.1.1.1 (rtt=22.4ms)'
test_cases.given: The WAN outage is still inside the 15-minute fire cooldown
test_cases.when: Engine processes the wan_up event at 2026-05-11T10:07:05Z
test_cases.then: No new Alert row is inserted for resolve; fakeDispatcher resolve count is 1 with severity='info' and message contains 'recovered' and duration '4m'
test_cases.expected_result: Resolve notification is immediate and notification-only

test_cases.title: Disabled WAN outage rule suppresses fire and resolve
preconditions: AlertConfig id=743 metric='wan_outage' severity='critical' enabled=0
NetEvent rows: id=3 kind='wan_down' at 10:03:00Z and id=4 kind='wan_up' at 10:07:00Z
test_cases.given: The only wan_outage rule is disabled
test_cases.then: Alert table row count is 0; fakeDispatcher fire count is 0; fakeDispatcher resolve count is 0
test_cases.expected_result: Disabled transition rule dispatches nothing

test_cases.title: Public IP change emits one info alert with old and new IP
preconditions: AlertConfig id=751 metric='public_ip_change' operator='==' threshold=0 severity='info' cooldown_minutes=60 enabled=1
NetEvent row id=5 ts=2026-05-11T11:00:00Z kind='public_ip_changed' detail='{"old":"1.2.3.4","new":"5.6.7.8"}'
test_cases.given: FR-026 previously observed public IP 1.2.3.4 and now emits old=1.2.3.4 new=5.6.7.8
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row exists with source='public_ip_change', severity='info', message containing '1.2.3.4' and '5.6.7.8'
test_cases.expected_result: One info alert reports both old and new IP values

test_cases.title: First public IP observation with empty old value is suppressed
preconditions: AlertConfig id=752 metric='public_ip_change' severity='info' cooldown_minutes=60 enabled=1
NetEvent row id=6 kind='public_ip_changed' detail='{"old":"","new":"5.6.7.8"}'
test_cases.given: ultron-ap has just restarted and FR-026 emits old='' new='5.6.7.8'
test_cases.then: Alert table row count is 0 and fakeDispatcher fire count is 0
test_cases.expected_result: Empty old IP is treated as no prior observation

test_cases.title: Disabled public IP change rule suppresses alert
preconditions: AlertConfig id=753 metric='public_ip_change' severity='info' enabled=0
NetEvent row id=7 kind='public_ip_changed' detail='{"old":"1.2.3.4","new":"5.6.7.8"}'
test_cases.given: The public_ip_change rule is disabled
test_cases.then: Alert table row count is 0 and fakeDispatcher fire count is 0
test_cases.expected_result: Disabled public-IP rule creates no alert

test_cases.title: Host CPU rule with sustained_duration=0 fires immediately like legacy behavior
preconditions: AlertConfig id=761 metric='cpu' operator='>' threshold=80 sustained_duration=0 severity='critical' cooldown_minutes=15 enabled=1
metrics snapshot at 2026-05-11T10:00:00Z has CPU.TotalPercent=81
test_cases.given: Existing host CPU rule was migrated with sustained_duration=0
test_cases.when: Engine evaluates one tick with CPU.TotalPercent=81
test_cases.then: Exactly 1 Alert row is inserted immediately with source='cpu', severity='critical', value=81
test_cases.expected_result: Legacy immediate fire behavior is preserved

test_cases.title: Host CPU rule with sustained_duration=180 fires only after 180s continuous breach
preconditions: SustainedWindow rule_id=762 duration=180s interval=5s threshold=80 operator='>'
test_cases.given: CPU values are 81 for 35 ticks from 10:00:00Z through 10:02:50Z and 81 again at tick 36 at 10:02:55Z
test_cases.then: eligible=false after tick 35 and eligible=true after tick 36; fire count before 10:03:00Z is 0 and at 10:03:00Z is 1
test_cases.expected_result: No early fire before the full 180s window

test_cases.title: Sample gap greater than two ticks resets sustained host window
preconditions: SustainedWindow rule_id=763 duration=300s interval=5s threshold=80 operator='>'
test_cases.given: CPU samples are 90 at 10:00:00Z, 90 at 10:00:05Z, then the next sample is 90 at 10:00:25Z
test_cases.when: The evaluator adds the third sample after a 20s gap
test_cases.then: The window length is reset to 1, eligible=false, and captured log contains 'rule_id=763' and 'reason=sample_gap'
test_cases.expected_result: Gap >10s resets the sustained window and does not fire

test_cases.title: Settings metric select renders exact metric options in order
preconditions: test server running with authenticated storage state
configured targets ['gateway','8.8.8.8','1.1.1.1']
test_cases.given: Browser is logged in and opens /settings#alerts at 375px viewport
test_cases.then: Option values equal exactly ['cpu','ram','disk','temp','latency','loss','dns_failure_rate','wan_outage','public_ip_change'] in that order
test_cases.expected_result: The metric select order matches FR-077 exactly

test_cases.title: Selecting wan_outage hides threshold fields and locks severity
preconditions: test server running with authenticated storage state
test_cases.given: Browser is on /settings#alerts and metric select currently has value='cpu'
test_cases.then: Elements [name='target'], [name='threshold'], [name='operator'], and [name='sustained_duration'] are not visible; severity control value is 'critical' and disabled; cooldown input remains visible
test_cases.expected_result: Transition-rule form shows only locked critical severity and editable cooldown

test_cases.title: Submitting latency rule swaps rules-table partial with new row
preconditions: test server running with authenticated storage state and target 'gateway'
initial rules table has 0 rows with text 'latency'
test_cases.given: Browser fills metric='latency', target='gateway', operator='>', threshold='100', sustained_duration='120', severity='warning', cooldown='15'
test_cases.when: Browser clicks submit and waits for htmx settle on #rules-table
test_cases.then: #rules-table contains one row with text 'latency', 'gateway', '100', '120', 'warning', and '15'; current URL remains '/settings#alerts'
test_cases.expected_result: Existing rules-table partial updates in place with the new network row

test_cases.title: Migration adds target and sustained_duration without changing existing row count
preconditions: tmpDB initialized with pre-feature AlertConfig schema and 11 rows: ids 1-11 metrics cpu,ram,disk,temp repeated
no target column exists before migration
test_cases.given: A v1 database contains exactly 11 AlertConfig rows
test_cases.when: The in-tree migration runner executes the network-alerts migration once
test_cases.then: PRAGMA table_info(AlertConfig) includes columns 'target' and 'sustained_duration'; SELECT COUNT(*) returns 11; SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE sustained_duration=0 AND target IS NULL returns 11
test_cases.expected_result: Forward migration preserves all rows and backfills default-compatible values

test_cases.title: Migration is idempotent on second run
preconditions: tmpDB already migrated once with 11 AlertConfig rows
test_cases.given: AlertConfig already has target and sustained_duration columns
test_cases.when: The same migration runner executes a second time
test_cases.then: Migration exits nil; captured log contains 'schema already at target version'; SELECT COUNT(*) returns 11
test_cases.expected_result: Second migration run is a no-op with explicit log

test_cases.title: Old AlertConfig SELECT shape still loads post-migration rows
preconditions: tmpDB migrated with one row id=1 name='CPU > 80' metric='cpu' operator='>' threshold=80 severity='critical' enabled=1 cooldown_minutes=15 target=NULL sustained_duration=0
test_cases.given: A downgraded loader executes SELECT id, name, metric, operator, threshold, severity, enabled, cooldown_minutes, created_at, updated_at FROM AlertConfig WHERE id=1
test_cases.when: The old struct without target and sustained_duration scans the row
test_cases.then: Scan returns nil error; loaded metric='cpu', threshold=80, cooldown_minutes=15
test_cases.expected_result: Extra columns do not break old explicit SELECT readers
